title: Initial Build Offer · Ravens Regime ↔ Big Balder Brand

targetAssets.name: 2028 2nd · Balder · Unslotted future pick · standardized round value

analysis.executiveSummary: Evaluating a proposal where Ravens Regime sends Derrick Henry to Big Balder Brand for Saquon Barkley and a 2028 2nd-round pick. While Big Balder Brand (an Elite Contender pursuing 'Win Championship') would eagerly accept upgrading their starting backfield with Henry's 90.5 C-AVI, the transaction actively contradicts Ravens Regime's goal to 'Increase Championship Odds'. Giving up Henry's dominant weekly production for Barkley—who is currently recovering from a week-to-week hamstring strain on a downgraded Philadelphia offense without Jalen Hurts—reduces Ravens Regime's immediate starting C-AVI by 30.2 points. To make this deal advance Ravens Regime's 2026 championship odds, the package must be revised to include a immediate startable asset like Chris Godwin.

submitted.summary: The submitted construction is heavily slanted toward Big Balder Brand. Big Balder Brand receives an elite 90.5 C-AVI RB1 in Derrick Henry to propel their championship push, while sending away an injured Saquon Barkley (60.3 C-AVI) and a distant 2028 2nd. For Ravens Regime, losing 30.2 C-AVI in starting power directly harms 2026 title odds.

recommended.summary: Revising the proposal to swap the 2028 2nd pick for wide receiver Chris Godwin (48.9 C-AVI) balances the immediate lineup impact. Ravens Regime gets younger at RB while adding Godwin to upgrade FLEX2, preserving 2026 championship capability while securing long-term age relief.

overall.summary: Substantial immediate hit to starting C-AVI power (-30.2 C-AVI) outweighs the minor age decrease and distant 2028 2nd pick capital.

title: Initial Build Offer · Northside Kings ↔ Ravens Regime

analysis.executiveSummary: Northside Kings proposes sending 33-year-old WR Mike Evans (77.9 C-AVI) to Ravens Regime in exchange for 25-year-old WR Josh Downs (50.2 C-AVI), 30-year-old TE Juwan Johnson (66.8 C-AVI), and a 2027 4th-round draft pick. This trade effectively leverages Evans' peak win-now value to fill a starting TE gap with Juwan Johnson while adding startable WR depth in Downs. For Ravens Regime, acquiring Evans creates an elite WR pairing with Zay Flowers while cleanly transitioning starting TE duties to Kyle Pitts. Market Reality evaluates this offer as Highly Realistic (94% acceptance probability) and recommends submitting the offer directly.

submitted.summary: Northside Kings capitalizes on Mike Evans' high championship value (77.9 C-AVI) to secure an immediate TE1 upgrade in Juwan Johnson (66.8 C-AVI) and youthful WR depth in Josh Downs (74.0 D-AVI). Ravens Regime acquires an elite starting WR anchor to pair with Zay Flowers.

recommended.summary: The proposed package is well-balanced, realistic, and directly addresses Northside Kings' TE position while utilizing Ravens Regime's highest available 2027 pick asset.

overall.summary: Positive overall portfolio improvement that addresses TE starting slot while acquiring a younger WR depth piece.

dynastyOutlook.summary: Trading a 33-year-old veteran WR for a 25-year-old slot receiver and a 30-year-old TE adds +69.8 net D-AVI.

lineupQuality.summary: Juwan Johnson immediately steps into TE1, allowing Stefon Diggs and Jordan Addison to handle WR duties.

depthResilience.summary: Josh Downs provides a high-floor PPR WR/FLEX option to protect against injuries.

overall.summary: Gains an elite WR starting asset in Mike Evans to bolster top-line championship scoring.

officialAviAnalysis.valueAssessment: Northside Kings holds the total C-AVI and D-AVI advantage, while Ravens Regime receives the single highest-value asset in Mike Evans.
